title: Cono J NDE 2914
content: I had started to bleeding two days before. On Friday morning, we went to the hospital and they told me I was having a miscarriage. The strange thing about it was that when they did the scan, the fetus was only nine weeks, but by my dates when I took the pregnancy test, I was twelve weeks. The last thing I remember before my experience was sitting on the toilet and saying to my partner that I wasn't feeling very well. The next thing I knew I was drifting, gliding, weightless as if in outer space. I was surrounded by an intense, warming feeling. There was no light, just the most amazing dark blue color everywhere. I was aware that I wasn't breathing but it didn't matter. All I felt was love, joy, happiness, and every wonderful emotion you could feel all at once. My thoughts had changed - not what I thought, but how I thought. Each thought was like a stone dropped into a still pool of water as if time had slowed (maybe it had for me). Then I became aware of others. There were hundreds of thousands of others. I couldn't see anyone's face at first, just their outlines. We were on the edge of a cliff. They were all waiting. I tried to see what they were all looking out at, but just as I was going to ask, a man in a very old uniform turned to face me and in a forceful voice said, 'You're not meant to be here!' The next thing I knew, I could hear my partner's voice. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 09 June 2002 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes miscarriage 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' Major blood loss. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I came to the cliff with the others. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither To me it felt like the experience lasted for at least fifteen to twenty minutes but I was later told by my partner it was only a matter of seconds and the I had had a seizure. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Neither Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I felt cocooned and even when I was starting to return and I heard my partner's voice he sounded a long way away. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Standing on a cliff's edge waiting. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? Joy, blessed, intense happiness, love, all the wonderful emotions you can experience all at once. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Conservative/fundamentalist god is everywhere Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Conservative/fundamentalist the same Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The intense emotions and the fact that I'm okay with death now when they're ready to have me. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes About a week, and no, everyone just thought I was crazy. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real The emotions stayed with me for weeks after, it was strange I had just had a miscarriage and had to have an operation of which went a bit wrong, so the nurse told me, while I was on the table I had an asthma attack and stopped breathing. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real The memories I have of that day are as strong as they were the day after it happened. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Prior to my experience I had a gift sometimes I knew things before they happened, people visiting without them ringing, and dreams of death which was a prediction of birth, but after my experience I suffered major depression and lost my gift. I miss it and wish I had it back. Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Prior to your experience did you have any spiritual gifts, dreams, visions?

arrival.other_being_detail: A man in a very old uniform spoke forcefully: 'You're not meant to be here!'

environment.environment_other_detail: Dark blue color everywhere; 'as if in outer space'; on the edge of a cliff.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Miscarriage with major blood loss; later reported asthma attack and stopped breathing; partner said she had a seizure.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Hundreds of thousands of others as outlines on a cliff edge; man in old uniform said, 'You're not meant to be here!'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE-like drifting in dark blue space, then presence of many others at a cliff boundary, then abrupt return on being told she was not meant to be there.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Dark blue 'outer space' environment with no light; many outlined beings waiting on a cliff; forceful statement from a man in a very old uniform: 'You're not meant to be here!'
